description: Pollution and Coral Health in the Virgin Islands is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Gulf Ecology Division; NOAA Office for Costal Management Digital Coast. Coral communities are under pressure from land-based pollutants and sediments. Now, coastal managers now can access an effective tool to correlate human land-use activity with coral reef condition. Resource managers can use this information to increase resilience for corals and the people who depend on them. Coverage: the United States (2021). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
